source: U.S. Census Bureau, Schedule C - Country List

schedule_c_extensions.GZ: Gaza Strip — ISO assigns PS to the State of Palestine as a whole; Census splits Gaza (GZ) and West Bank (WE).
schedule_c_extensions.KV: Kosovo — no assigned ISO 3166-1 code (XK is only a private-use convention); Census assigns KV.
schedule_c_extensions.WE: West Bank — ISO assigns PS to the State of Palestine as a whole; Census splits Gaza (GZ) and West Bank (WE).
